theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_cyl_slice_covector_bound
theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Euclid (N + 1)) (n + 1)) (v : Fin n → Euclid N) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) n, |α v| ≤ c * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → |γ (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))| ≤ c * covectorEuclideanNorm γ
